classification: EXPERIMENTAL PROTOCOL (specialist foundation training). Not PAPER-FAITHFUL.
authorized_by: PI, 2026-09-26: after the sealed 2v2 certification (5f7c6892), train the standardized 2v2 foundation pi_A, pi_B at 1M steps with the SA-PPO anchor OFF, using the same generalized trainer and certified pole handoff as the 4v4/6v6 methodology.
STAGE: canonical lineage step 1 of: 1M base specialist (anchor OFF) -> entity-repair continuation -> split pi_D (k=1, N' teacher) -> Separated crossover -> CD dataset -> distilled suite arms. This spec authorizes step 1 ONLY.

RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_base.entity_repair: OFF at this stage (it is the next, separate continuation stage, as at 4v4)
RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_base.resolved_config_check: a 5,000-step smoke's resolved config differs from the 4v4 base run in 47 keys, none substantive: max_blue_agents 4 -> 2 (the scale); run identity (seed, run_tag, paths); smoke-only (total_timesteps, periodic_checkpoint_steps, formal_run, progress bar); and fields added to PPOConfig after the 4v4 base ran, every one at an inert default (all lambdas 0.0, all *_enabled False). The real launch's own run_config is re-diffed at start.

POLES.source: the sealed 2v2 certification, through pole_attestation.resolve_pole_genome -> certified_pole_genome (requires VERDICT=CERTIFIED and a SEALED record)
POLES.verified: 2v2 trainer dry-runs for policy A and policy B: certification gate CERTIFIED; live pole hash == certified hash (MATCH PASS; policy B also live-attested)

SEEDS.class_rationale: mirrors the current standardized pipeline's training-seed registration (SCALE_6V6_ENTITY_REPAIR_BASE_PAIR_V2_TRAINING, exploratory)

LAUNCH.order: sequential: A then B (one GPU; the 6v6 locked pipeline runs the pair in parallel only with two GPUs)
LAUNCH.cost: about 132 steps/s steady state (measured on the smoke), so about 2.1 h per policy, about 4.2 h sequential
LAUNCH.crash_recovery: periodic checkpoints every 100,000 steps; resume with --resume <ckpt.zip>

DONE_WHEN: both final checkpoints exist and each run_manifest records a live pole attestation MATCH against STRATEGIC_DEMAND_2v2_CERTIFICATION.json
each resolved run_config differs from its 4v4 base counterpart only in the categories listed under RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_base
the cross-scale identity attestation (Layers 1-3) is re-run and 2v2's base rows are read from these artifacts
NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: the entity-repair continuation, the split pi_D, any crossover, dataset collection or distillation (each needs its own frozen spec and registered seeds)
any Pole B candidate override at 2v2
reusing the natural-setup 2v2 teachers (SAPPO continuation, r1_*) as warm starts: the foundation is trained fresh, as the 4v4 base was
